label: For "Clinical Quality Performance Anomaly Detection": Detect unexpected changes in quality indicators across facilities, units, specialties and time, and tell analysts whether a change is more likely a data problem or a real performance shift before escalating. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Treating data defects as performance.
